_note: Max-pressure options: hysteresis (docs/decisions.md D20), capacity (D22) and serve_queue (D32). Used by --controller maxpressure_hyst (hysteresis), maxpressure_hyst_cap (both) and maxpressure_hyst_cap_serve (all three); plain maxpressure stays the basic version. gain_pcu: switch only when the best phase beats the current one by more than this many PCU. capacity (D22): an approach adds no positive pressure while the approach it feeds holds at least spillback_occupancy x (length x lanes / jam_spacing_m) PCU. jam_spacing_m is a PLACEHOLDER. serve_queue (D32): keep a green while its approach still has hold_pcu_per_lane x lanes queued and can discharge, up to max_green_s; the envelope's max red still applies.
